ItemBGDesc: A special freebie for pre-ordering Slumbernana Monkey dolls, showcasing sub-par quality. Once the dolls arrive, the monkey dolls will autonomously follow the signal from this freebie to reach its purchaser. "Why do we give a lousy doll to the buyers first, BananAdvisor?" "1. To enhance the quality of the official doll. 2. To provide instant positive feedback upon their purchase. 3. To offer them a means to show off on social platforms before the goods arrive."
